strings.en: Hm, what's up, Tenkawa? Staring at that guy's robot?
Oh, uh, no reason...
I'm just glad this thing didn't lose its pilot...
Yeah... But he still hasn't regained consciousness, right?
There's no telling if he'll cooperate with us.
It's not about whether he cooperates with us or not...
I'm just glad a guy who loves Gekiganger that much didn't die...
I bet this robot feels the same way...
Tenkawa, you're a real poet today, huh.
Hikaru... you all came here too? How was the bridge?
Nothing much. Akatsuki and that Erina vanished somewhere,
and Minato's glued to that Gekigan nut's bedside nursing him,
so it was pretty empty.
Tender care... tenderloin... Heh...
Don't worry, Tenkawa.
Shiratori's gonna join us for sure. I guarantee it!
Yeah... this thing lost its pilot...
I wonder what'll happen to it...
Yeah... Well, it may have lost its pilot,
but it's valuable research material. They won't throw it away.
I see...
But it had such a good guy as its pilot...
Maybe this thing was happy too...
...Tenkawa, you're a real poet today, huh...
Hikaru... you all came here too? How was the bridge?
Nothing much. Akatsuki and that Erina are still missing,
and Minato's shut herself up in her room.
Dammit...! We didn't make it in time...!
Just a few minutes... that's all it would've taken...
Tenkawa... You're right, man.
This Gekigan knockoff must've been happy to have Shiratori as its pilot.
Yamada, you sure sound confident.
Damn straight! Him and me...
...But is it really that simple...? Tenkawa, you were there, right?
...Yeah... "There's only one justice"... Major Shiratori
and the Jovian commander both said the same thing...
It means justice ain't just one thing. ...Not that I like it.
Yeah... that's how it was. That there's as many kinds of justice as people...
I'd never even thought about it...
...But listen! Anyone who'd shoot his own comrade has no justice!
We're not the ones in the wrong!
Forget it... Just forget it... Justice and all that...
No, I won't forget it! Come on, Tenkawa!
There's something I gotta show you!
H-Hey, wait...! Okay, okay, quit pulling me...
They're gone...
What's Yamada planning to show him, anyway...
Isn't it obvious?
There's only one thing that guy's that crazy about.
Our mission: peace in space and a future for humanity. Our dream!
We do not seek conflict. Needless killing is truly meaningless.
But the Earth Federation government, cowards that they are,
answered us by killing our envoy, Colonel Tsukumo Shiratori!!
But everyone, we must not lose heart! There is only one justice!!
That's right. We will surely defeat the evil Earth!
So watch over us, everyone! Like in episode 39 of
"Hot-Blooded Robot Gekiganger 3," we will fight. Justice always wins!
Now, let us all shout it together! The watchword of justice!!
Leeet's... GEKIGA-IIIN!!
Captain Bright, we've wiped out the Meganoids,
and Major Shiratori's treatment is done. How long are we staying here?
Captain Bright, we've wiped out the Meganoids.
Major Shiratori... it didn't end the way we'd hoped, but...
how long are we staying here?
Tetsuya, choose your words more carefully...
The people who went to the Meganoid base only just got back.
Tsurugi has a point... but there's still something here that concerns me.
Here... Now that the Meganoids are beaten,
the problems left on Mars are the ruins they'd occupied, and...
The Za Boom Army.
We beat Charm, but...
Yeah. Unless we take down that bastard Emperor Annex...
the fight with the Za Boom Army won't be over.
...You needn't worry about that.
Ilbora!? You've woken up!?
...Thank goodness... Ilbora...
...Princess... Joe, I...
Shut up. ...Around here, even a guy like you
won't get turned away. ...So start over, Ilbora.
He could've said that a lot nicer.
Big Bro never was one for being straightforward.
...Forgive me.
Ilbora, raise your head.
...What do you mean? What about Annex?
Yes... Annex was caught in the explosion of planet Dirad...
He's already dead...
Huh!? You bastard, still spouting that garbage at a time like this!?
...If I meant to trap you, I'd tell a better lie than that.
Though I heard this from Hazard.
Why was Emperor Annex in such a place?
The Emperor left the solar system invasion to me and another officer,
and meant to return to the Schema system...
I don't know why he was there... but the Terahertz, Annex's ship,
was confirmed to have exploded.
Not that there's any way to check, with the Mars base blown sky-high.
So the Za Boom Army won't attack anymore?
That was kind of anticlimactic...
No... The Za Boom Army hasn't been wiped out.
This star system has merely escaped invasion.
...Princess Romina, return to the Schema system and planet Radorio...
No.
Princess Romina...!?
We can't abandon Earth's people and go back to the Schema system alone.
Besides, the Elshank is Londo Bell's flagship.
...This is no longer just our problem, Ilbora...!
...Understood.
Ilbora, we beat Charm, but...
Yeah. Unless we take down that bastard Emperor Annex...
the fight with the Za Boom Army won't be over.
About that... it looks like we don't need to worry.
Hm? Banjo, what do you mean?
...What do you mean? What about Emperor Annex?
...Emperor Annex was caught in the explosion of planet Dirad...
He's already dead.
What!? C'mon, Banjo, quit it with the weird jokes, will ya?
Maya, it's no joke...
We found that information while we were searching the Meganoid base.
Then... why was Emperor Annex in such a place?
We don't know the details, but it seems the Meganoids got
info on the Za Boom from that Ilbora guy. And in that info...
Not that there's any way to check now.
So the Za Boom Army won't attack anymore?
That was kind of anticlimactic...
No... The Za Boom Army has not been wiped out.
This star system has merely escaped invasion.
...Princess Romina, return to the Schema system and planet Radorio...
No.
Princess...!?
We can't abandon Earth's people and go back to the Schema system alone.
Besides, the Elshank is Londo Bell's flagship.
...This is no longer just our problem...!
...Understood.
Princess Romina's changed, hasn't she?
Heh, she's gotten pretty radical.
Hard to believe... Can it really be that easy?
...Believe it or not, we can't confirm it. ...But then our problems on Mars
are down to just one...
The ruins the Meganoids had occupied, huh?
When the Nadesico went off on its own without us before,
it was because Nergal wanted to secure those ruins, right, Captain?
All right, Londo Bell will head for the Mars polar ruins at once.
Contact the Nadesico too!
Captain, emergency transmission from the Nadesico!
What? Put it through.
Captain Bright! It's terrible. At the polar ruins...
...Nergal's made its move, I take it?
Huh...? Y-Yes, that's right!
Banjo...?
The ex-Nergal people on the Nadesico probably noticed, right?
The two who vanished before the last battle...
The pilot Akatsuki and... there was one more.
Vice-helmsman Erina.
Right, those two.
Those two aren't just ordinary Nergal employees, are they?
Huh...? R-Really?
Former champion skirt-chaser Nagare Akatsuki... Current position...
Huh? Isn't that the same name as Nergal's chairman?
What're you talking about!? It's the same guy!
Ho ho. He seemed to believe he had hidden it well,
so I refrained from saying anything so tactless.
R-Really!?
You hadn't noticed? ...Captain.
Huh... But why would Mr. Long Hair do something like that?
Personally auditing his company's troubled flagship, I suppose.
I think he just came along for fun.
A-Anyway, we got word that Nergal troops have deployed at the ruins!
Hey, Bright, those ruins are pretty damn suspicious, right?
We ain't gonna just leave 'em alone, are we?
Right. All right, we'll make for the Mars ruins at once.
All ships, alert stations!
Why's Mars got so much trouble...
It might be better than Earth... but I wish peace would come soon.
Approaching the Mars polar ruins.
Akatsuki, did you really come here...
Transmission from the Kakitsubata... It's Akatsuki!
Hey there, everyone. Quick to arrive, as expected.
Akatsuki... no, Chairman Akatsuki. I'd like you to explain yourself.
Oh, you already figured it out...
And here I wanted to reveal my true identity in grand style...
Spare us the speech and answer! What's the deal with those ruins?
What are you after!?
Now, now, don't get so worked up. Nergal discovered those ruins.
It'd be a waste just to guard them from the Jovian Lizards and the rest.
...So you plan to keep whatever's inside all to yourself, huh?
What on earth is in those ruins...
...It was a coincidence at first. Nergal opened a mine at the Martian pole.
Buried beneath it were enormous ruins.
Prospector? You knew?
Well, I am a Nergal employee, after all.
...The ruins have the same composition as the Tulip crystals,
and what's more, parts of the ruins are still operating even now.
Question. Why does that matter? Is it some amazing weapon or...
It is merely a system.
Our research shows that when an object emerges from a Tulip,
or when a so-called Boson Jump occurs, the system's reaction
becomes more active. In other words...
Ugh... Hayato, I don't get any of this. Explain it simple for me later.
Sure. For now, just shut up and listen.
In other words, a Boson Jump control system?
Exactly! If we unravel that system, we can monopolize
the use of biological Boson Jumps...
If we monopolize the ruins before the Federation or Jupiter get them,
we'll not only end the war, but in the coming
age of Boson Jump exploration, we'll hold humanity's greatest trump card.
Company this, company that... Climbing the ladder, huh...
What!? You got a problem with that!?
Nah, nah, you're just so great...
So great, so greeat.
Get ahead, get ahead... and you might get your head handed to you...
So, I got a little bit of a head start.
I'm the first one to the ruins, after all.
No cheating now. Ha ha ha ha!
...Prepare the Phase Transition Cannon for firing...!
What!? Captain Misumaru!
Target: the center of the polar ruins!
Roger.
Hold it right there!!
Wh-What's the meaning of this, Yurika Misumaru!?
Meaning nothing! It's things like that that start wars!
Well, that's taking it to extremes.
Wait, Captain Misumaru.
Those ruins will be a crucial key in our war with the Jovian Alliance!
We can't let Nergal alone monopolize them...
Captain Bright, it can't be helped, but...
...Very well.
All units, we'll subdue Nergal's forces. Prepare to launch!
...I figured it'd come to this...
Can't be helped. Aestivalis team, launch!
I thought the fighting was finally winding down...
and now Earthlings are fighting each other again...
No kidding! I'm gonna tie up that long-haired creep and teach him!
Their machines probably have Distortion Fields,
so even if we shoot them down, they'll have a chance to escape...
but we'll still need to be careful...
Who cares about that!? Let's all just sortie already!
Wh-What the!?
This is that thing we saw on the Nadesico...
Why? What? Nadesico.
Hello. I'm Inez Fressange.
Everyone's favorite, Why? What? Nadesico, has reached its finale.
This time, we'll take an in-depth look at the Boson Jump.
It's definitely... the show from back then, but...
Kyosuke, you've seen it?
Inez...? Why!? From where!?
I've pinpointed the source of the signal.
Where!?
The lowest level of the ruins, about 14 km down.
Inside the ruins...? Since when... And how!?
According to John Wheeler and Richard Feynman,
when we generate a single radio wave, two waves are emitted.
These are the retarded wave and the advanced wave!
...Hey, do you get any of this...??
Nope... not really... How about you, Mia?
I don't really get it, but it seems important... What about you, Pai?
W-Well, my memory's still kinda fuzzy... Ha ha ha!
A retarded wave travels forward in time. Like the ones TV uses.
And an advanced wave is one that travels backward in time...
a wave that goes into the past.
Normally, the advanced wave is canceled out by the retarded wave.
Ugh... I-I don't get it...
K-Kosuke...
Hyoma, be quiet!
But what if an unknown particle didn't interfere with the retarded wave?
A particle that doesn't interfere with retarded waves... Incredible...
But if such a thing existed...!
No way... Matter turned into those particles would go to the past!?
Correct. ...I named that particle the Retrospect.
If we think it through this way,
the Boson Jump, which we thought was spatial transport,
is in fact time travel. Or so we can infer.
Keiko, I'm kinda getting sleepy...
I don't really get it either...
I'm done trying to understand...
And if that inference is correct,
then what adjusts the time lag of that brief trip into the past
may well be these very ruins.
If so... like the Nadesico tried to do just now,
if we destroy these ruins...
Brother?
From the present into the past, and then
back to the present again: spacetime transfer by Retrospect particles.
Silently running those calculations... this place is a giant computer...
If it were gone, Boson Jumps would never be possible again.
Show, I'm sleepy......
No, don't sleep, Cham. There might be a battle coming. Stay awake!
Boson Jump... that's
the teleporting the Nadesico and Jovian Lizards do, right?
...Point is,
these ruins are a huge computer for that teleporting, right?
Yes. It's the final Why? What? Nadesico, so I went long. But that's it.
Well, proving that theory is one thing,
but there's one more reason I came here... Akito!
Huh?
Come to the ruins... I have to welcome someone...
With these ruins, I could call you here even without a CC...
but that would activate the ruins... So come here, Akito.
Y-Yes. ...Captain Bright...?
...It can't be helped.
...It seems Ms. Fressange knows more about the ruins than any of us.
Go, Tenkawa.
...Understood.
Inez... she looked... so terribly sad...
...Utopia Colony, Rainbow Elementary. Grade 1, Class 5, No. 12.
Favorite person... Mommy... Favorite food, spaghetti...
Favorite story, Cinderella...
He'll be here soon. ...I've already met him...
but "you" haven't met him yet, have you...
I... you know, I...
.........It's all right... ...It's all right, you don't have to cry... ...Welcome home...
